s0202.literal: On gengzi day Taizhou of Liaoyang Province was redesignated Taibining Prefecture.
s0202.idiomatic: On gengzi day Taizhou of Liaoyang Province was redesignated Taibining Prefecture.

s0203.literal: On renyin day one hundred National University students were added, with four companion-readers presented annually as tribute.
s0203.idiomatic: On renyin day 100 National University students were added, with four companion-readers presented annually as tribute.

s0204.literal: An edict directed the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat to print ten thousand copies of Essentials of Agriculture and Sericulture, distribute them to administering officials for observance and agricultural encouragement.
s0204.idiomatic: An edict directed the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat to print 10,000 copies of Essentials of Agriculture and Sericulture, distribute them to administering officials for observance and agricultural encouragement.

s0205.literal: The wife of Guizhou darughachi Xiang Yuansun, Tuotuozhen, was commended posthumously for martyrdom in virtue, and a stele was ordered erected at his post.
s0205.idiomatic: The wife of Guizhou darughachi Xiang Yuansun, Tuotuozhen, was commended posthumously for martyrdom in virtue, and a stele was ordered erected at his post.

s0206.literal: Ninth month, on dingwei day Zhang Lü, through land survey, drove nine persons to death; Minister of Personnel Wang Juren and others were ordered to investigate.
s0206.idiomatic: Ninth month, on dingwei day Zhang Lü, through land survey, drove nine persons to death; minister of personnel Wang Juren and others were ordered to investigate.

s0207.literal: On jiyou day the moon encroached upon Fang.
s0207.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon encroached upon Fang.

s0208.literal: On jiayin day the sun's color was like ochre.
s0208.idiomatic: On jiayin day the sun's color was like ochre.

s0209.literal: On xinyou day Venus encroached upon the Left Law Enforcer.
s0209.idiomatic: On xinyou day Venus encroached upon the Left Law Enforcer.

s0210.literal: On renxu day Cai Wujiu's followers dispersed and were executed upon capture; the remaining partisans were all pacified; an edict rewarded soldiers' merit in pursuit and capture, and enfeoffed the descendants of those who died in service.
s0210.idiomatic: On renxu day Cai Wujiu's followers dispersed and were executed upon capture; the remaining partisans were all pacified; an edict rewarded soldiers' merit in pursuit and capture, and enfeoffed the descendants of those who died in service.

s0211.literal: On jisi day the Dianyou Granary was moved to Chijin territory.
s0211.idiomatic: On jisi day the Dianyou Granary was moved to Chijin territory.

s0212.literal: Prince Betieemuer was granted land-tax revenue of Yongchang Route and Xiliang Prefecture.
s0212.idiomatic: Prince Betieemuer was granted land-tax revenue of Yongchang Route and Xiliang Prefecture.

s0213.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingzi new moon: a guest star appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0213.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, bingzi new moon: a guest star appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0214.literal: On dingchou day Tuohuochi was enfeoffed Prince of Weining Commandery and granted a gold seal; Hu'erchi Temür Buhua was made Duke of Zhao State.
s0214.idiomatic: On dingchou day Tuohuochi was enfeoffed Prince of Weining Commandery and granted a gold seal; Hu'erchi Temür Buhua was made Duke of Zhao State.

s0215.literal: On gengchen day Huai-Xi surveillance commissioner Guo Guan was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0215.idiomatic: On gengchen day Huai-Xi surveillance commissioner Guo Guan was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0216.literal: On renwu day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0216.idiomatic: On renwu day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0217.literal: Public fields were granted to the Yunnan surveillance commission.
s0217.idiomatic: Public fields were granted to the Yunnan surveillance commission.

s0218.literal: On yiwei day associate privy council administrator Temür Toqa was promoted to privy council administrator.
s0218.idiomatic: On yiwei day associate privy council administrator Temür Toqa was promoted to privy council administrator.

s0219.literal: White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren was appointed Grand Master for Glorious Blessings and Minister of Works.
s0219.idiomatic: White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren was appointed Grand Master for Glorious Blessings and minister of works.

s0220.literal: On dingyou day Temüder was additionally appointed Grand Preceptor.
s0220.idiomatic: On dingyou day Temüder was additionally appointed grand preceptor.

s0221.literal: On guimao day Babai Xifuman dispatched envoys presenting two tame elephants; silks and cloths were granted in return.
s0221.idiomatic: On guimao day Babai Xifuman dispatched envoys presenting two tame elephants; silks and cloths were granted in return.

s0222.literal: Eleventh month, on bingwu day a guest star transformed into a comet, transgressing the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and passing through fifteen lodges from Zhen to Bi; it disappeared only on gengyin day of the second month of the following year.
s0222.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on bingwu day a guest star transformed into a comet, transgressing the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and passing through 15 lodges from Zhen to Bi; it disappeared only on gengyin day of the second month of the following year.

s0223.literal: On xinwei day, on account of the stellar anomaly, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, with graded remission of corvée levies and taxes on each route.
s0223.idiomatic: On xinwei day, on account of the stellar anomaly, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, with graded remission of corvée levies and taxes on each route.

s0224.literal: On jiaxu day Hosishu was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and granted a gold seal.
s0224.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Hosishu was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and granted a gold seal.

s0225.literal: Left Chancellor Hesan and others said: "The comet's anomaly is caused by our lack of talent; we wish to yield the path to the worthy.
s0225.idiomatic: Left chancellor Hesan and others said, "The comet's anomaly is caused by our lack of talent; we wish to yield the path to the worthy.

s0226.literal: " The Emperor said: "This is Our fault — how could it be caused by you?
s0226.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is Our fault — how could it be caused by you?

s0227.literal: Return to your posts; if governance has errors, do not fear reform.
s0227.idiomatic: Return to your posts; if governance has errors, do not fear reform.

s0228.literal: Whatever can settle the people should all be spoken; then above and below may jointly cultivate, and celestial anomalies may be stilled."
s0228.idiomatic: Whatever can settle the people should all be spoken; then above and below may jointly cultivate, and celestial anomalies may be stilled."

s0229.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day Yunnan branch secretariat associate administrator Wang Chang'an was granted a tiger tally to share in military affairs.
s0229.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on wuyin day Yunnan branch secretariat associate administrator Wang Chang'an was granted a tiger tally to share in military affairs.

s0230.literal: On gengyin day the Pingjiang Route circulating treasury was additionally established.
s0230.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Pingjiang Route circulating treasury was additionally established.

s0231.literal: On guisi day notes were issued to purchase sheep and horses to relieve the northern frontier armies.
s0231.idiomatic: On guisi day notes were issued to purchase sheep and horses to relieve the northern frontier armies.

s0232.literal: Provincial officials were ordered to draft general regulations for posthumous enfeoffment and conferrals, so that rank may suit circumstance and be reported.
s0232.idiomatic: Provincial officials were ordered to draft general regulations for posthumous enfeoffment and conferrals, so that rank may suit circumstance and be reported.

s0233.literal: Lai Lusun of Ninghua County, Tingzhou, was commended for filial conduct.
s0233.idiomatic: Lai Lusun of Ninghua County, Tingzhou, was commended for filial conduct.

s0234.literal: Third year, spring, first month, on yisi day Hanyang Route suffered famine; grain was released for relief.
s0234.idiomatic: Third year, spring, first month, on yisi day Hanyang Route suffered famine; grain was released for relief.

s0235.literal: Sibaochi Balqasun's darughachi Tuohuan was specially appointed Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Radiance and Grand Marshal, and a seal was granted as before.
s0235.idiomatic: Sibaochi Balqasun's darughachi Tuohuan was specially appointed Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Radiance and grand marshal, and a seal was granted as before.

s0236.literal: On bingwu day former central secretariat left chancellor Quludai'er was enfeoffed Duke of Shou State; four judicial officials for the Prince of Jin's department, two directors of waterways, and one department director were additionally established.
s0236.idiomatic: On bingwu day former central secretariat left chancellor Quludai'er was enfeoffed Duke of Shou State; four judicial officials for the Prince of Jin's department, two directors of waterways, and one department director were additionally established.

s0237.literal: Because Zhending and Baoding repeatedly suffered famine, hunting was forbidden.
s0237.idiomatic: Because Zhending and Baoding repeatedly suffered famine, hunting was forbidden.

s0239.literal: On xinyou day associate privy council administrator Mailu was promoted to privy council administrator.
s0239.idiomatic: On xinyou day associate privy council administrator Mailu was promoted to privy council administrator.

s0240.literal: On renxu day two hundred qing of Jiang-Zhe fields were granted to Shangdu's Kaiyuan Temple, one hundred qing to Huayan Temple; Prince of Zhao Aruqtu's following was granted twenty thousand ingots of notes.
s0240.idiomatic: On renxu day 200 qing of Jiang-Zhe fields were granted to Shangdu's Kaiyuan Temple, 100 qing to Huayan Temple; Prince of Zhao Aruqtu's following was granted 20,000 ingots of notes.

s0241.literal: Second month, on dingchou day one thousand Han garrison troops of Haikou Storage were mobilized, placed under the Linqing grain-transport commander of ten thousand, to supply relay transport; two thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0241.idiomatic: Second month, on dingchou day 1,000 Han garrison troops of Haikou Storage were mobilized, placed under the Linqing grain-transport commander of ten thousand, to supply relay transport; 2,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0242.literal: On wuyin day the Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to instruct Annam to restore the King of Zhanla.
s0242.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to instruct Annam to restore the King of Zhanla.

s0243.literal: Tutors were established for Prince of Anyuan Chouhan.
s0243.idiomatic: Tutors were established for Prince of Anyuan Chouhan.

s0244.literal: Hejian, Jinan, Bin-Di, and other places suffered famine; grain was granted for two months.
s0244.idiomatic: Hejian, Jinan, Bin-Di, and other places suffered famine; grain was granted for two months.

s0245.literal: Third month, on xinhai day Koryo crown prince Wang Gao was specially appointed Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies and Prince of Shen; Minister of Construction Lü Tianlin was additionally appointed Grand Preceptor of the Palace.
s0245.idiomatic: Third month, on xinhai day Koryo crown prince Wang Gao was specially appointed commissioner with the ceremonial standing equal to the Three Excellencies and Prince of Shen; minister of construction Lü Tianlin was additionally appointed grand preceptor of the palace.

s0246.literal: On jiayin day Xiaobaizhu and one official each from Shaanxi and Sichuan provinces were ordered to escort the Prince of Zhou to Yunnan; the Prince of Zhou's Attendants' Office was established at second rank, with seven attendants, four chamberlains, and two deliberators and two recorders each.
s0246.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiaobaizhu and one official each from Shaanxi and Sichuan provinces were ordered to escort the Prince of Zhou to Yunnan; the Prince of Zhou's Attendants' Office was established at second rank, with seven attendants, four chamberlains, and two deliberators and two recorders each.

s0247.literal: The Hunt-Falconry and Artisans Overall Directorate was established, with six officials and eight judicial officials;
s0247.idiomatic: The Hunt-Falconry and Artisans Overall Directorate was established, with six officials and eight judicial officials;

s0248.literal: six officials each for the Yanfu Bureau and Food and Drink Office;
s0248.idiomatic: six officials each for the Yanfu Bureau and Food and Drink Office;

s0249.literal: all subordinate to the Prince of Zhou's Attendants' Office.
s0249.idiomatic: all subordinate to the Prince of Zhou's Attendants' Office.

s0250.literal: On xinyou day the Directorate of Astronomy was promoted to second rank.
s0250.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Directorate of Astronomy was promoted to second rank.

s0251.literal: On guihai day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0251.idiomatic: On guihai day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0252.literal: On renshen day Boluo and others of the Falconry Office disturbed the people at Datong; an edict ordered their commissioned seals and letters confiscated and returned.
s0252.idiomatic: On renshen day Boluo and others of the Falconry Office disturbed the people at Datong; an edict ordered their commissioned seals and letters confiscated and returned.

s0253.literal: Hunting throughout the realm during spring was forbidden.
s0253.idiomatic: Hunting throughout the realm during spring was forbidden.

s0254.literal: Summer, fourth month, guiyou new moon: the Emperor's elder sister the Grand Eldest Princess was granted five thousand ingots of notes and two hundred bolts of silks and cloths.
s0254.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guiyou new moon: the Emperor's elder sister the Grand Eldest Princess was granted 5,000 ingots of notes and 200 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0255.literal: Henan refugees gathered in groups crossing the river, disturbing places passed through; branch secretariat and surveillance commission officials were ordered to relieve them with confiscated notes in current storage.
s0255.idiomatic: Henan refugees gathered in groups crossing the river, disturbing places passed through; branch secretariat and surveillance commission officials were ordered to relieve them with confiscated notes in current storage.

s0256.literal: The Yao tribesmen of Hengzhou became bandits; Huguang Province was ordered to dispatch troops to pursue and capture them.
s0256.idiomatic: The Yao tribesmen of Hengzhou became bandits; Huguang Province was ordered to dispatch troops to pursue and capture them.

s0257.literal: On renwu day the central secretariat was instructed that Prince of Wei Amuge should receive ten thousand ingots of notes annually.
s0257.idiomatic: On renwu day the central secretariat was instructed that Prince of Wei Amuge should receive 10,000 ingots of notes annually.

s0258.idiomatic: An edict directed the magistrates of Weihui and Changping to repair the shrines of Yin Bi Gan and Tang dynasty Di Renjie, with seasonal sacrifices offered.

s0259.literal: On wuzi day the Sutra Printing Intendant Office was promoted to the Guangfu Directorate.
s0259.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Sutra Printing Intendant Office was promoted to the Guangfu Directorate.

s0260.literal: On jichou day Huifu Court was promoted to second rank.
s0260.idiomatic: On jichou day Huifu Court was promoted to second rank.

s0261.literal: On guisi day Prince of Anyuan Chouhan was granted five hundred taels of gold, one thousand ingots of notes, and twenty bolts of silks and cloths.
s0261.idiomatic: On guisi day Prince of Anyuan Chouhan was granted 500 taels of gold, 1,000 ingots of notes, and 20 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0262.literal: On jihai day two judicial officials for the Prince of Zhou were additionally established.
s0262.idiomatic: On jihai day two judicial officials for the Prince of Zhou were additionally established.

s0263.literal: Because Huai-Dong surveillance commissioner Miao Haoqian excelled at supervising the people's agriculture and sericulture, one suit of clothing was granted.
s0263.idiomatic: Because Huai-Dong surveillance commissioner Miao Haoqian excelled at supervising the people's agriculture and sericulture, one suit of clothing was granted.

s0264.literal: On gengzi day Shangdu resident commissioner Hanlaher was made privy council administrator; Shuxiang Court was promoted to second rank.
s0264.idiomatic: On gengzi day Shangdu resident commissioner Hanlaher was made privy council administrator; Shuxiang Court was promoted to second rank.

s0265.literal: The central secretariat together with the censorate, Hanlin Academy, and Academy of Scholarly Worthies were ordered to jointly deliberate general regulations for posthumous enfeoffment and conferrals, and establish them as statutes.
s0265.idiomatic: The central secretariat together with the censorate, Hanlin Academy, and Academy of Scholarly Worthies were ordered to jointly deliberate general regulations for posthumous enfeoffment and conferrals, and establish them as statutes.

s0266.literal: Gai Prefecture of Liaoyang and Nanfeng Prefecture suffered famine; granaries were opened for relief.
s0266.idiomatic: Gai Prefecture of Liaoyang and Nanfeng Prefecture suffered famine; granaries were opened for relief.

s0267.literal: From jiachen to wushen in the fifth month, the sun was red like ochre.
s0267.idiomatic: From jiachen to wushen in the fifth month, the sun was red like ochre.

s0268.literal: On xinhai day Jiangxi branch secretariat right chancellor Wochi was made Grand Preceptor of the Palace.
s0268.idiomatic: On xinhai day Jiangxi branch secretariat right chancellor Wochi was made grand preceptor of the palace.

s0269.idiomatic: On gengshen day Dadu resident commissioner Bo Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor; central secretariat right vice chancellor Xiaobaizhu was promoted to grand councillor; left vice chancellor Abuhaiya was made right vice chancellor; associate administrator Guo Guan was made left vice chancellor; deliberator Buhua was made associate administrator.

s0270.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Gansu Confucian Studies Intendant Office and Liaoyang Gold, Silver, and Iron Smelting Intendant Office were established, both at fifth rank supplementary grade.

s0271.idiomatic: Princes Dieleger Bukhua and others were granted 350 taels of gold, 1,200 taels of silver, 3,200 ingots of notes, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.

s0272.idiomatic: Tan, Yong, Baqing, Guiyang, Li, Dao, Yuan, and other routes suffered famine; grain was released and sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0273.idiomatic: Sixth month, on yihai day by statute Mencius's father was enfeoffed Duke of Zhu State and his mother Lady Xuanxian of Zhu State.

s0274.idiomatic: Commandery and district vice prefects and assistant magistrates in princes' and meritorious officials' appanage territories were changed to deputy darughachis; middle and lower counties and recorders' offices each had one deputy darughachi additionally established.

s0275.literal: On bingzi day the Yao tribesmen of Rong, Bin, and Liuzhou rebelled; Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch officials to supervise troops in capture.
s0275.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Yao tribesmen of Rong, Bin, and Liuzhou rebelled; Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch officials to supervise troops in capture.

s0276.literal: On dingchou day an edict directed: "For capital crimes, whoever at execution dares to add mutilation beyond the sentence shall be judged by the heavy penalty.
s0276.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict directed, "For capital crimes, whoever at execution dares to add mutilation beyond the sentence shall be judged by the heavy penalty.

s0277.literal: In all interrogations, do not apply cruel torture except in robbery cases.
s0277.idiomatic: In all interrogations, do not apply cruel torture except in robbery cases.

s0278.literal: " On wuyin day Prince of Wu Dilegenei and others' following lacked food; grain was granted for two months.
s0278.idiomatic: On wuyin day Prince of Wu Dilegenei and others' following lacked food; grain was granted for two months.

s0279.literal: On jimao day an edict instructed all offices each diligently to perform their duties and not neglect great governance.
s0279.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict instructed all offices each diligently to perform their duties and not neglect great governance.

s0280.literal: On jiashen day Prince of Anyuan Chouhan was granted a branch privy council seal.
s0280.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince of Anyuan Chouhan was granted a branch privy council seal.

s0281.literal: On dinghai day Chuangwu'er was enfeoffed Prince of Jurong Commandery.
s0281.idiomatic: On dinghai day Chuangwu'er was enfeoffed Prince of Jurong Commandery.

s0282.literal: On dingyou day the Prince of Zhou's following guards were granted four hundred thousand ingots of notes.
s0282.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Prince of Zhou's following guards were granted 400,000 ingots of notes.

s0283.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Bianliang, inundating dwellings; Gai Prefecture of Liaoyang suffered famine — grain was all released for relief.
s0283.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its banks at Bianliang, inundating dwellings; Gai Prefecture of Liaoyang suffered famine — grain was all released for relief.

s0284.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on renzi day censor-in-chief Boho and Tuohuan Darqan were ordered to restore censorate discipline, and an edict was additionally promulgated to instruct inner and outer.

s0285.literal: On yimao day Yulong Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Bao'en and granted a gold seal.
s0285.idiomatic: On yimao day Yulong Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Bao'en and granted a gold seal.

s0286.literal: On xinyou day one hundred seventy qing of Yidu fields were granted to Puqing Temple.
s0286.idiomatic: On xinyou day 170 qing of Yidu fields were granted to Puqing Temple.

s0287.literal: On bingyin day Yan Temür was again made privy council administrator.
s0287.idiomatic: On bingyin day Yan Temür was again made privy council administrator.

s0288.literal: On gengwu day one thousand five hundred Koryo, Jurchen, and Han troops were dispatched to garrison-farm at Binzhou, Liao River, Qingyun, and Zhao Prefecture.
s0288.idiomatic: On gengwu day 1,500 Koryo, Jurchen, and Han troops were dispatched to garrison-farm at Binzhou, Liao River, Qingyun, and Zhao Prefecture.

s0289.literal: Eighth month, on guiyou day Minister of War Qita was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0289.idiomatic: Eighth month, on guiyou day minister of war Qita was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0290.literal: On jimao day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0290.idiomatic: On jimao day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0291.literal: On wuxu day the Buddha-Image Weaving Artisans Regulatory Office was established at seventh rank, with two officials.
s0291.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Buddha-Image Weaving Artisans Regulatory Office was established at seventh rank, with two officials.

s0292.literal: Ninth month, on xinchou day Wutiao River garrison-farm was restored; central secretariat left vice chancellor Guo Guan was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies; grand academician Wang Yi was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.
s0292.idiomatic: Ninth month, on xinchou day Wutiao River garrison-farm was restored; central secretariat left vice chancellor Guo Guan was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies; grand academician Wang Yi was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.

s0294.literal: On guichou day Venus appeared in daytime.
s0294.idiomatic: On guichou day Venus appeared in daytime.

s0295.literal: On jiwei day Jining and Jinning routes suffered earthquake.
s0295.idiomatic: On jiwei day Jining and Jinning routes suffered earthquake.

s0296.literal: On bingyin day Venus transited the heavens.
s0296.idiomatic: On bingyin day Venus transited the heavens.

s0297.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on xinwei day Jiangnan branch censorate attendant censor Gao Fang was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0298.literal: On renshen day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0298.idiomatic: On renshen day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0299.literal: Two thousand Sichuan troops and three thousand Yunnan troops were mobilized to garrison-farm at Wumeng and other places; an overall commander-of-ten-thousand office was established at third rank, with four officials, subordinate to Yunnan Province.
